standard_prerequisites.name: A flat finite graded module over a graded polynomial ring over a local ring is finitely presented
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives finite presentation after localising at each of the primes.

standard_prerequisites.name: Local finite presentation plus injectivity into the product of the localisations gives global finite presentation
standard_prerequisites.use: Glues the local statements into the required global one.

core_obligations: Present the algebra as a finite algebra over a graded polynomial ring using homogeneous generators (proof lines 5928-5933).
Reduce both statements to the case where the algebra is that graded polynomial ring (proof lines 5933-5936).
Apply the graded module theorem at each of the finitely many primes and glue using the injectivity assumption (proof lines 5937-5941).
proof_roadmap: Reduction to a graded polynomial ring (proof lines 5928-5936).
Gluing along the finite set of primes (proof lines 5939-5941).
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves finite presentation for a flat finitely generated graded algebra and for a flat finite graded module, assuming the ring injects into the product of its localisations at finitely many primes. The proof uses the chosen homogeneous generators to present the algebra as a finite algebra over a graded polynomial ring, which reduces both statements to the case of a graded polynomial ring, where the earlier graded module theorem gives finite presentation after localising at each of the finitely many primes; the injectivity assumption then lets the local finite presentation statements be glued into global finite presentation. The reduction steps are each justified.
